# Criticality_Based_Biomarker

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A diagnostic metric derived from the deviation of sleep EEG criticality exponents from healthy baseline, used to predict dementia progression. Enables edge-AI inference in neuromorphic hardware for continuous, low-power cognitive health tracking in wearable or in-network devices.
